name: tennis-buddee-video
description: Reveal + demo video for Tennis Buddee (Remotion). Edit src/config/* to change copy, timing and footage.

scripts.render:reveal: npm run assets && remotion render Reveal out/reveal.mp4
scripts.render:demo: npm run assets && remotion render Demo out/demo.mp4
scripts.render:song: npm run assets && remotion render RevealSong out/reveal-song.mp4
scripts.render:hype: npm run assets && remotion render Hype out/hype.mp4
